HUMAN SCALE / Inner perception & dreams

Clairaudience & clairsentience.

Terms used for experiences interpreted as intuitive hearing or feeling, often described as internal impressions.

LEXICON / LANGUAGE & MEANING

Names in context.

Clairaudience
Clariaudiencia

An experience interpreted as hearing information beyond an identified ordinary auditory source.

Clairsentience
Clarisentiencia

A feeling or bodily impression interpreted as intuitive information; usage varies by practitioner.

PROVENANCE & INTERPRETATION

A practice,
a setting.

These words have varying meanings in spiritual and parapsychological writing. This entry documents the reported sensory quality and the interpretation offered by its source, without treating the experience as an independently verified message.

Human scale
SOURCES & CONTEXT
APA Dictionary — Clairaudience ↗APA Dictionary — Extrasensory perception ↗
FIELD NOTE / METHOD

Keep a record.

  1. Describe the experience in ordinary sensory words before giving it an interpretation.
  2. Note the setting, time, external sounds and relevant prior expectations.
  3. Retain an unedited account and any later comparisons as separate records.
POTPOURRI / PHOTO GUIDE

What to include.

  • Submit a dated transcription or drawing of the experience.
  • If sound is relevant, describe the recording and its context; a photograph cannot establish an unheard source.

POTPOURRI / PERSONAL INTERPRETATION

Share a photograph or a record.

A photograph, drawing or dated record can be sent privately for a personal reading. Include the procedure and the question.
